source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**AIRCRAFT** units can make only an **[Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)**, no other type. Also:

- When your opponent's turn ends, return each of your **AIRCRAFT** units on the battlefield to **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**.
- Models making any move can pass through **AIRCRAFT** models.
- During a **[Pile-In](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move)**, [Consolidation](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) or **[Surge move](vsdata:core-rule/surge-move)**, a unit that cannot **[FLY](vsdata:core-rule/flying-models)** ignores **AIRCRAFT** when picking enemy units and finding the closest one.
- Being **[Engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** only with **AIRCRAFT** still lets a unit make a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** or **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, if it meets their other requirements.
